# Price Validation Report — UNOBTANIUM_DB vs. market evidence

**Date:** 2026-09-10
**Generated by:** `scraper/validate_prices.py` (quarterly automated re-validation)
**Scope:** top 50 parts by live-inventory exposure (frequency × displayed high).
**Evidence baseline:** manual audit of 2026-09-09 (`scraper/price_baseline.json`); fresh eBay sold prices attempted per run (0 part(s) used fresh data).

## Verdict counts

| Classification | Count |
|---|---|
| ACCURATE | 33 |
| UNDERSTATED | 0 |
| INFLATED | 0 |
| UNVERIFIABLE | 17 |

**Rules:** displayed (calibrated) range vs. observed evidence range. INFLATED = displayed low above the observed ceiling, or displayed high > 1.5x it. UNDERSTATED = displayed high below the observed floor. UNVERIFIABLE = a part rose into the top exposure list with no reviewed evidence.

Prices are never edited automatically. INFLATED and UNVERIFIABLE rows need a human decision; when corrections are accepted, bump `PRICES_LAST_REVIEWED` in `scraper/junkyard_scraper.py` and refresh `scraper/price_baseline.json`.
